newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai parent may use stake for cash.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai parent may use stake for cash.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday its parent, Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Co Ltd (SIIC), might use its Shanghai Industrial stake to raise cash in the future.

"SIIC has indicated that it will at (an) appropriate time... explore the possibility of utilising certain of its assets, including its shareholding in the company (Shanghai Industrial) appropriately for various financing arrangements," Shanghai Industrial said in a statement published on Tuesday.
But Shanghai Industrial said SIIC had also indicated it would not relinquish its controlling shareholder position and had not cut its stake in the company.
The statement followed selling of the red chip on Monday after rumours of a stake reduction by its parent.
Shanghai Industrial shares hit a low of HK$39.00 before ending at HK$40.40, down HK$2.80.
